attribute.name: infoAverageInterval_s
attribute.description: Time interval over which IS averages are calculated (in s).

attribute.name: histogramVerbosity
attribute.description: Parameter to control the number of histrograms published in OH. The higher the value the more technical histograms are published.

attribute.name: hiddenParameters
attribute.description: Entry point for rescue parameters

attribute.name: dynamicUpdate
attribute.description: Set to true to enable dynamic updates of some configuration parameters via user commands

attribute.name: samplerBufferSize
attribute.description: Number of events that can be buffered

attribute.name: maxConnectDelay_s
attribute.description: In order to spread the system load during the connect transition the DCM will sleep a random amount of time between zero and this attribute (in s).

attribute.name: sbaDirectory
attribute.description: Path to the directory where the SBA file will be created

attribute.name: sbaBaseName
attribute.description: Base name to construct the full file name

attribute.name: sbaNumOfBlocks
attribute.description: Number of blocks in the array. Each block is supposed to contain all the ROB fragments of one event. NB: the number of blocks must be greater that the number of HLTPUs in the host. NB: the total SBA size in MiB is: numOfBlocks * blockSize

attribute.name: sbaBlockSize_MiB
attribute.description: Block size in MiB. NB: it must be greater that maximum event size.

attribute.name: sbaRecoveryMode
attribute.description: Select event recovery procedure in case of Dcm crash. NONE: do nothing; FILE: events dumped on the local file system; SFO: events delivered to SFO

attribute.name: compressionAlgorithm
attribute.description: Algorithm used to compress the full event payload

attribute.name: UpperEdgeSizeHistos
attribute.description: Upper edge of the histograms related to fragment size (kB)

attribute.name: UpperEdgeTimeHistos
attribute.description: Upper edge of the histograms related to time intervals (ms)

relationship.name: dataCollector
relationship.description: It manages the ROB fragments request

relationship.name: processor
relationship.description: It manages the interface with HLTPU (daq::dfinterface)

relationship.name: output
relationship.description: It manages the full event output

attribute.name: delayDistribution_us
attribute.description: Distribution of the ROB fragment collection delay in microseconds according to the syntax defined in dccommon::Distribution.

attribute.name: robSizeDistribution_words
attribute.description: Distribution of the ROB fragment sizes in words, according to the syntax defined in dccommon::Distribution.

attribute.name: delayDistribution_us
attribute.description: Distribution of the L1Result fetching delay in microseconds, according to the syntax defined in dccommon::Distribution

attribute.name: sizeDistribution_words
attribute.description: Distribution of the CTP fragment sizes in words, according to the syntax defined in dccommon::Distribution.

attribute.name: nUnits
attribute.description: Number of emulated processor processing units.

attribute.name: l2ProcessingTimeDistribution_ms
attribute.description: L2 processing time distribution in ms according to the syntax defined in dccommon::Distribution

attribute.name: l2RequestsDistribution
attribute.description: Number of requested fragments distribution according to the syntax defined in dccommon::Distribution

attribute.name: l2RequestsPerSourceDistribution
attribute.description: Number of fragments requested from each source distribution according to the syntax defined in dccommon::Distribution, or the string NULL to disable source-aware requests

attribute.name: l2Acceptance
attribute.description: Average acceptance for event building

attribute.name: efProcessingTimeDistribution_ms
attribute.description: EF processing time distribution in ms according to the syntax defined in dccommon::Distribution

attribute.name: efAcceptance
attribute.description: Average EF acceptance

attribute.name: directory
attribute.description: Directory where the event data files are written.

attribute.name: storageAcceptance
attribute.description: If different from 1, specifies the fraction of events that are actually stored.

attribute.name: maxClearDelay_ms
attribute.description: Maximum event clear delay in milliseconds. If different from 0, clears are cached until they can be piggybacked on a new event request or the delay expires.

attribute.name: processingTimeOut_ms
attribute.description: PU processing time-out in milliseconds. At expiration the event is forcefully accepted.

attribute.name: maxOutputEvents
attribute.description: Maximum number of events waiting for output delivery. If exceeded, the DCM will stop asking for L1 results.

relationship.name: bcidCheckIgnoreSubdetectors
relationship.description: Set of sub-detectors whose fragments are not checked for BCID mismatches

relationship.name: bcidCheckSilentSubdetectors
relationship.description: Set of sub-detectors whose fragments' BCID mismatches are not reported in ERS

attribute.name: markDoneAfterEventBuilding
attribute.description: True if markDone should be sent after event building, otherwise it is called after event has been sent to the SFO

attribute.name: nRequestCredits
attribute.description: Maximum number of outstanding ROS requests (0 means unlimited)

attribute.name: requestTimeout_s
attribute.description: Maximum amount of time to wait for a response to a ROS request (s)

attribute.name: requestTimeout_s
attribute.description: Maximum amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a transfer request from a SFO after an event was assigned to it.

attribute.name: acknowledgmentTimeout_s
attribute.description: Maximum amount of time, in seconds, to wait for an acknowledgment from a SFO after an event was transferred to it.

attribute.name: onlyLocalSfo
attribute.description: If set, this instance will connect only to SFO applications running on the same node.
